specification.title: Duplicate IP discovery executes only one pivot
specification.description: The same IP is discovered twice; only one pivot executes.
specification.purpose: Verify that discovering the same IP twice suppresses the duplicate so exactly one pivot executes.
specification.operational_relevance: Real provider environments surface the same entity through multiple paths; duplicate pivots waste budget and pollute trajectories.
specification.regression_risk: The coordinator could execute the same entity identity twice or double-charge the provider budget.

required: The discovered-IP pivot executes exactly once
The provider budget accounts for the suppressed duplicate
forbidden: The investigation pivots the same discovered IP more than once
